thread:
maria: Hey team — preflight for the marketplace announcement week. Need a quick sync on landing page variants, localized press assets, and SI partner readiness. Who's owning translation signoff?

devon: I can own translations. Will need final copy by EOD Tue for vendor turnaround. Which locales are priority?

maria: Priority: en-US, en-GB, de-DE, fr-FR, ja-JP, ko-KR. APAC press window needs ja/ko by Tue COB. EMEA tolerates Wed.

sam: Noted — I'm managing the landing page builds. How many variants?

maria: Three variants: 1) Public product landing (marketing), 2) Partner co-sell landing with SI badges, 3) HW partner case study spotlight. All must support locale switch and canonical hreflang.

lina: For variant 2 we need partner logos + legal name approvals. Jordan, can you confirm SI logo list?

jordan: Yup — sending the final SI matrix in 30m. Mostly standard SVGs, 2 partners need updated logos (Nimbus & EdgeCloud). @abby please triage legal approvals for those two.

abby: On it. I'll ping legal and loop back by EOD.

sam: For builds I need the following by Tue 5pm PT: hero copy per variant, 3 screenshots (web+mobile), and partner logos (SVG). If translations land late we can swap in later but page must be live with en-US.

maria: Good. Press assets: single embargoed PR + partner quotes file. Dev & infra folks — any known outages or scheduled maintenance during our cutover Fri 10am PT?

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy maintenance window: 4995015000 - 4995018600 (Fri 09:30 - 10:30 UTC).

devon: That overlaps the cutover. Can we shift the deploy to avoid the embargo cutover?

sam: We can move cutover to Fri 12pm PT if infra agrees. That buys extra buffer for last-minute hooks.

maria: I prefer earlier to hit APAC morning. What's the risk if maintenance overlaps?

jordan: Maintenance is kube node patching — potential 30s router flaps. Not ideal during press. Recommend shifting maintenance.

devon: I'll ask infra to reschedule to Sat. Standby for confirmation in ~15.

maria: Thanks. Back to assets — partner quotes: we have two options: (A) include full SI quote in PR, (B) publish neutral PR and follow with partner blog with quote. Thoughts?

lina: Option B reduces legal churn for big SI but requires coordinated blog timing. Could push partner blogs + press within 24h.

abby: Legal prefers B for 3rd-party approvals. Also avoids embedding partner-specific case numbers in headline.

maria: OK — neutral PR on go-live, partner co-posts within 24h. Make sure partner blogs have canonical links to the landing co-sell variant.

sam: Does marketing have an approved canonical structure? I need URL patterns for redirects and hreflang.

jordan: Use: /marketplace/[partner-slug]/[locale] with canonical on en-US version, and link rel alternate hreflang mapping. I'll add to the SI matrix doc.

maria: Translation owners — confirm vendor SLA for ja/ko turnaround. Devon?

devon: Vendor SLA 48h for final copy. If we push legal earlier we hit it.

maria: Cool. Quick checklist (please ack):
```
- Translations: devon (due Tue EOD)
- Landing builds: sam (en-US live Tue, localized swap Wed)
- SI matrix/logos: jordan (send CSV + SVGs)
- Legal approvals: abby (Nimbus & EdgeCloud)
- Press PR: marketing (neutral) + partner blog follow-ups
- Announce cutover: Fri 12pm PT (pending infra reschedule)
```

devon: ack.

sam: ack. Will build feature flags for variant toggles and provide preview URLs.

lina: I'll pre-draft partner co-post template and share for quotes.

jordan: SI matrix uploaded: https://redwood-internal.s3/si-matrix-4995012345.csv (mock link). Logos in /assets/partners/4995/.

abby: Legal confirmed Nimbus logo update approved, EdgeCloud pending trademark check (ETA Wed AM).

maria: Great. One more: press embargo windows — staggered by region to reduce load. Proposal: EMEA & Americas embargo lift at Fri 12:00 PT, APAC embargo lift Fri 23:00 PT (Sat morning local). Agree?

jordan: Agree. APAC regionally staggered to avoid overnight spikes.

devon: infra approves reschedule — maintenance moved to Sat.

maria: Perfect. Last mile: can we run a smoke test of the co-sell landing webhook to SI badge data by Thu morning? Sam/devon — can you coordinate?

sam: Yes. I'll put a quick test endpoint and share curl.

devon: Will standby to validate headers and 200 responses.

maria: Awesome team. I'll compile this into the announce runbook and ping again after legal + translations confirm. If anyone hits blockers, post here and tag me. :rocket: 

sam: preview URLs when ready: https://staging.redwood.com/marketplace/preview/co-sell-en-us + /preview/partner-hw-en-us

jordan: Uploaded final SI logos v2 to /assets/partners/4995/logos-v2.zip

abby: EdgeCloud trademark cleared. All logos cleared.

maria: Closing loop — next sync Thu 10am PT for final signoffs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
